paragraphs.en: A standalone USB Wi-Fi auditor for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
paragraphs.zh: 一款适用于 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 的独立 USB Wi-Fi 审计工具。

paragraphs.en: At least one of the supported USB adapters is required .
paragraphs.zh: 至少需要一个受支持的 USB 适配器。

paragraphs.en: Important: At least one supported USB wireless adapter is required.
paragraphs.zh: 重要提示：至少需要一个受支持的 USB 无线网卡。

paragraphs.en: Breakdown of each device's capabilities and limitations: Supported Hardware Doc .
paragraphs.zh: 各设备能力与限制的细分：Supported Hardware 文档。

paragraphs.en: Download the latest standalone executable from Releases :

paragraphs.zh:
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine wifit3-macos-universal2

paragraphs.en: uv sync uv run wifit3 Option 3: Build your own binary uv run pyinstaller wifit3.spec --noconfirm --clean Binary executable is written to dist/ subdirectory.

paragraphs.zh: 将之前安装的设备交还给您操作系统的 Wi-Fi 协议栈：

paragraphs.en: On Linux, this deletes wifit3's udev and modprobe rules. On Windows, this uninstalls the WinUSB binding, and triggers a PnP device rescan (old driver reattaches).
paragraphs.zh: 在 Linux 上，这会删除 wifit3 的 udev 和 modprobe 规则。 在 Windows 上，这会卸载 WinUSB 绑定，并触发一次 PnP 设备重新扫描（旧驱动程序会重新挂载）。

paragraphs.en: wifit3 only exists because of the great people who reverse-engineered and maintained these Linux wireless drivers. It's usually a thankless job.
paragraphs.zh: wifit3 之所以存在，全靠那些对 Linux 无线驱动进行逆向工程并加以维护的杰出人士。 这通常是一份吃力不讨好的工作。

sents.en: wifit3 only exists because of the great people who reverse-engineered and maintained these Linux wireless drivers.
sents.zh: wifit3 之所以存在，全靠那些对 Linux 无线驱动进行逆向工程并加以维护的杰出人士。
这通常是一份吃力不讨好的工作。

paragraphs.en: wifit3 bypasses the operating system's native Wi-Fi stack entirely. It ships with lightweight Python ports of Linux kernel drivers ( src/wifit3/chips/* ) that directly control wireless devices over USB bulk and control transfers.
paragraphs.zh: wifit3 完全绕过了操作系统的原生 Wi-Fi 协议栈。 它内置了 Linux 内核驱动程序的轻量级 Python 移植版本（src/wifit3/chips/*），通过 USB 批量传输和控制传输直接控制无线设备。

sents.en: wifit3 bypasses the operating system's native Wi-Fi stack entirely.
sents.zh: wifit3 完全绕过了操作系统的原生 Wi-Fi 协议栈。

sents.en: It ships with lightweight Python ports of Linux kernel drivers ( src/wifit3/chips/* ) that directly control wireless devices over USB bulk and control transfers.
sents.zh: 它内置了 Linux 内核驱动程序的轻量级 Python 移植版本（src/wifit3/chips/*），通过 USB 批量传输和控制传输直接控制无线设备。

paragraphs.en: Because register-level frame injection and monitor mode are performed entirely in user space, Windows NDIS restrictions and Linux kernel driver locking do not apply.
paragraphs.zh: 因为寄存器级别的帧注入和监听模式完全在用户空间中执行，所以 Windows NDIS 的限制和 Linux 内核驱动程序的锁定机制均不适用。

paragraphs.en: For architecture details, driver porting methodology, and USB trace replay tooling, see the Porting Documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 有关架构细节、驱动程序移植方法以及 USB 追踪回放工具，请参阅移植文档（Porting Documentation）。

paragraphs.zh: 固件：加载到适配器上的厂商固件文件按原样重新分发，遵循各制造商的许可证（详情见 FIRMWARE.md）。

paragraphs.en: ⚠️ Notice & Disclaimer: For use only on networks and equipment you own or are explicitly authorized to audit. wifit3 operates directly on USB hardware registers without kernel guardrails; use at your own risk.
paragraphs.zh: ⚠️ 注意与免责声明：仅限在你拥有或明确获授权审计的网络与设备上使用。wifit3 直接操作 USB 硬件寄存器，没有内核层面的防护机制；使用风险自负。
